originals.citation: Root, J. R., Cox, S. K., Davis, K., & Gonzales, S. (2022). Using augmented reality and modified schema-based instruction to teach problem solving to students with autism. Remedial and Special Education, 43(5), 301-313.

quote: In this distal conceptual replication of Root et al., contextual and instructional variables of theoretical and practical importance were intentionally manipulated or maintained and reported to model transparency and support replicability.
notes: Abstract names 'Root et al.' without a year; full text paywalled. Matched to the Root et al. study that used the same combination of modified schema-based instruction and augmented reality with students with autism (@root2021, online 2021 / print 2022). Other Root entries (@root2016 SBI with manipulatives; @root2020 VRA; @root2018 contextualizing) are plausible but less specific.
